decision: YouTube is a runtime-toggleable optional provider. Store metadata must not position YouTube download/extraction as a primary feature for Play/Izzy channels.

github.rationale: GitHub Releases/Obtainium users choose full functionality. YouTube toggle defaults to enabled.
github.metadataPolicy: Full feature list including YouTube discovery is acceptable in GitHub README and release notes.

izzyOnDroid.rationale: IzzyOnDroid permits proprietary dependencies and extraction libraries. YouTube toggle defaults to enabled.
izzyOnDroid.metadataPolicy: YouTube feature is listed but framed as optional source provider, not primary product pitch.

fdroidMainline.rationale: F-Droid mainline is blocked until a real FOSS flavor exists. YouTube extraction through NewPipe/yt-dlp is GPL-compatible but Firebase blocks inclusion regardless.

play.rationale: Play IP policy is restrictive around unauthorized downloads and cached audiovisual content. YouTube toggle should default to enabled but listing metadata must not promote unauthorized downloading.
play.metadataPolicy: Do not use phrases like 'download YouTube audio', 'save YouTube videos', 'YouTube ripper'. Frame as 'discover ringtones from YouTube' with clear attribution. Screenshots must not show YouTube download progress or cache management.

disabledBehavior: YouTube video sources skipped in Video Wallpapers
Existing YouTube favorites remain accessible but marked as provider-disabled
